summary: Ardmore Shipping Corp filed a Form 6-K containing its quarterly earnings report for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes financial statements and MD&A typical of a routine periodic report. There is no mention of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. The filing is a standard required disclosure for a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation event. No deal terms or structural changes are present.
